statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service was to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The diagnosis codes on the claim are G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
